import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline


# Define the custom CUDA kernel for element-wise division (x / norm)
# We need to implement Frobenius norm normalization: x / ||x||_F

elementwise_div_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void elementwise_div_kernel(const float* a, const float* norm_val, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] / norm_val;
    }
}

torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor norm_val) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_div_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), norm_val.data_ptr<float()>, out.data_ptr<float()>, size);

    return out;
}
"""

elementwise_div_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor norm_val);"
)

# Compile the inline CUDA code for division by Frobenius norm
elementwise_div = load_inline(
    name="elementwise_div",
    cpp_sources=elementwise_div_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=elementwise_div_source,
    functions=["elementwise_div_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[],
)


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.frobenius_norm = elementwise_div

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Compute Frobenius norm of the input tensor
        norm_val = torch.norm(x, p='fro')
        return self.frobenius_norm.elementwise_div_cuda(x, norm_val)


def get_inputs():
    batch_size = 112
    features = 64
    dim1 = 512
    dim2 = 512

    x = torch.rand(batch_size, features, dim1, dim2).cuda()
    return [x]


def get_init_inputs():
    return []


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = ModelNew()
    out = model(get_inputs())
    print(out.shape)
